rows.grounds: compound adjective from putra and prada

items.question: What result follows when women bind the amulet on the left arm?
premises: The amulet is bound on the left arm.
This practice applies specifically to women.
Such binding is held to grant a son.
items.inference: Therefore, for women, binding the amulet on the left arm is considered to bestow a son.
items.plain_english: But for women, when bound on the left arm, it is considered to grant a son.
